1	# EO FM 校准论文：三个核心研究问题的审查标准
2	
3	版本：2026-09-18
4	用途：供 Codex 与 Claude Code 审查实验是否遗漏、比较是否合理、证据是否足够回答研究问题。
5	性质：审查规范，不是对当前仓库或实验结果已经完成的审计。
6	
7	## 1. 已确认的研究范围与完成定义
8	
9	本轮必须回答：
10	
11	- RQ1：不同 EO foundation models 在下游适配后，预测概率的校准程度如何？
12	- RQ2：不同 fine-tuning 方式是否、以及怎样影响 calibration，同时怎样影响任务性能？
13	- RQ3：加入 Temperature Scaling、MC Dropout、Deep Ensemble 后，calibration 能否改善，是否以任务性能下降为代价？
14	
15	本轮的“代价”首先指分类 accuracy、分割 mIoU 等任务性能。计算成本可作为补充说明，不因此新增一套核心实验。
16	
17	完成标准是：在已声明的模型、数据集、任务和训练协议范围内，用有效对照与可追溯结果回答上述问题，并如实表达不确定性。
18	“没有发现稳定差异”“某方法没有改善”“效果因任务而异”都可以是合格答案。不能为了得到预期正结果而要求继续训练。
19	
20	OOD、corruption、label scarcity、表征探针、CKA、架构干预、AU/EU 分解、机制解释等不自动属于本轮必需实验。若论文已经对这些方面作出实质性主张，标出该主张的证据缺口，单独列为范围决策；不要静默把它们并入三问。
21	
22	本规范中的验收要求是为本项目提出的研究标准，不是学校或导师正式评分规则。
23	
24	## 2. 先确定实验矩阵，才能判断“遗漏”
25	
26	从当前配置、协议与 run 记录提取以下维度：
27	
28	- 模型及预训练权重版本；
29	- 数据集、任务定义、标签处理、输入模态/波段；
30	- 适配方式及实际可训练模块；
31	- 重复训练 seed；
32	- 方法：deterministic / TS / MC Dropout / Deep Ensemble；
33	- train、selection/validation、calibration、final evaluation 的实际样本索引；
34	- checkpoint 选择规则、指标定义、结果位置。
35	
36	历史方案可作为查找线索：DOFA、Panopticon；EuroSAT、TreeSatAI、CloudSEN12、SpaceNet7；frozen backbone + trained head 与 full fine-tuning。这些不是当前结果已完成的证明。以仓库中的现行协议核实，不自动要求第三个 FM。
37	
38	覆盖审查：
39	
40	| 研究问题 | 必须能形成的比较块 | 什么才算遗漏 |
41	| --- | --- | --- |
42	| RQ1 | 相同任务、数据和可比较适配条件下，不同 FM 的 deterministic 结果 | 某个已经承诺的模型/数据/适配条件缺少有效结果；只展示最好 seed；只有性能而没有校准证据 |
43	| RQ2 | 同一 FM、同一数据集、同一评估集下，frozen 与 full 的成对结果 | 两种适配没有可比对照；某一侧缺失；不同数据或不同 UQ 后处理混在一起比较 |
44	| RQ3 | 每个已声明的比较块中，deterministic 与所研究方法的结果 | 方法没有对应基线；只展示改善的组合；校准前后不是同一评估集 |
45	
46	不强制无条件完成所有维度的笛卡尔积。但必须列出“已承诺范围”和“实际覆盖范围”，每个缺失组合标记为缺失、无效或有依据的不适用。部分覆盖只能支持相应范围的结论。不能在看见不利结果后静默缩小矩阵。
47	
48	新增传统模型基线只有在论文声称“FM 相比非 FM 更好”等对应主张时，才成为该主张的必要对照。只比较不同 EO FM 的三问，不自动要求新增一整套 CNN/ViT 基线。
49	
50	## 3. 三问共用的有效性要求
51	
52	| ID | 核查事项 | 通过条件与失败边界 |
53	| --- | --- | --- |
54	| C01 | 最终评估数据隔离 | 最终报告数据没有参与梯度训练、checkpoint/超参/温度/阈值选择。若同一 validation 既用于调参又用于最终结论，说明这是选择后的评估，不能当作独立验证 |
55	| C02 | Calibration 数据用途 | TS 等拟合数据与最终评估数据分离。selection validation 与 calibration 数据复用不自动判为无效，但必须披露，并保留未用于这些选择的最终评估。没有单独命名为 calibration 的 split，不等于必然需要重训 |
56	| C03 | 标签、输出和任务一致 | 核对 multiclass、multilabel 或 binary 任务；损失、softmax/sigmoid、决策规则、性能指标和校准定义一致。标签变换有依据且在文中说明 |
57	| C04 | 模型实际执行正确 | 权重加载、输入波段/顺序/归一化、输出维度、训练模块与声明相符；frozen 实际冻结、full 实际更新；异常参数遗漏、随机初始化或数据损坏不会被误当作科学现象 |
58	| C05 | 指标实现一致 | ECE 的置信度定义、分箱、空箱、单位、聚合方式明确；NLL 使用匹配任务的概率模型；Brier 的类别求和/平均归一化明确。统一 ignore mask、有效样本、类别顺序和概率截断策略 |
59	| C06 | 数据对应与结果可追溯 | 每项表格数字有 run/配置/代码版本/checkpoint/评估样本来源。采样预测与标签 ID 对齐；可从保存的 logits/probabilities 独立重算关键指标 |
60	| C07 | 重复与统计单位正确 | 报告既定独立训练重复的逐次结果及摘要。像素和 MC forward 不作为独立训练重复；训练配方一致的独立 ensemble 成员可用于单模型跨 seed 统计，但一个 ensemble 的多个成员不能计为多个独立 ensemble。若给区间，明确它反映训练随机性还是评估样本不确定性 |
61	| C08 | EO 数据相关性得到处理 | 检查重复、重叠、同一地点/时间组是否造成与目标不符的信息泄漏。区间估计按合理独立单位或组进行；不把相邻像素当作大量独立证据。共享 AOI 是否合理取决于声明的泛化目标，不能机械判错 |
62	| C09 | 选择与异常处理透明 | checkpoint 规则在比较组内一致且不使用最终评估集；失败 run、排除项、缺失值及未定义指标有记录。只看完整且有效的运行；不因结果难看而删除 |
63	
64	指标解释约束：
65	
66	- ECE 是特定经验校准误差；top-label ECE 主要回答“预测类别的置信度是否匹配正确率”，不能独自证明完整类别概率向量处处校准。
67	- NLL/Brier 是概率预测质量指标，不是校准误差的同义词。它们与 ECE 的变化可以不一致，应分开报告和解释。
68	- 不设“ECE 小于 0.05 即通过”之类无依据的普适阈值。比较结果要注明任务、样本和指标定义。
69	- 如果主结论依赖很小的 ECE 差异，或 ECE 与其他证据矛盾，利用已有预测检查适量替代分箱/类条件指标；无需为此默认重训。
70	- 多 seed 若仅有少数重复，应保留逐 seed 数据，不把一个宽泛的显著性标签当作全部证据。没有显著差异，不自动证明两种方法相同。
71	- 若使用 bootstrap，比较组在同一重采样中使用同一批样本/组，并明确是否只条件于固定训练模型。不能把评估集抽样区间称为跨 seed 稳定性。
72	
73	校准定义与温度缩放参考：[Guo et al., 2017](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v70/guo17a.html)。
74	ECE 选择可能影响比较结论，参考：[Nixon et al., 2019/2020](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.01685)。
75	
76	## 4. RQ1：不同 EO FM 在下游适配后校不校准？
77	
78	分析对象：未经 TS 等后处理的 deterministic 预测；每种适配条件分别展示。
79	
80	| ID | 具体审查事项 | 足够回答问题所需的证据 |
81	| --- | --- | --- |
82	| R1.1 | 模型对照是否可比 | 在相同数据集、标签、输入信息及评估集的比较块内比较 FM；记录模型要求的预处理差异。若输入模态或适配方案不同，结论限定为整个配置的差异 |
83	| R1.2 | 是否同时展示性能和校准 | 单标签分类报告 accuracy、ECE-15、NLL、Brier；分割报告 mIoU、per-class IoU、pixel accuracy 与对应概率指标。多标签任务采用与其任务匹配的指标，不能套用 argmax accuracy |
84	| R1.3 | 是否能判断过度或不足自信 | 提供 reliability diagram 和每箱样本数/置信度分布。检查偏离方向；ECE 本身没有方向，平均 confidence-accuracy gap 也可能掩盖不同分箱方向抵消 |
85	| R1.4 | 是否被类别不均衡掩盖 | 对类别不均衡的分割至少检查关键类别概率校准及类别性能。以 SpaceNet7 为例，整体 pixel accuracy/ECE 不足以说明建筑物类表现；检查建筑物概率与建筑物标签事件的对应关系 |
86	| R1.5 | 模型差异是否稳定且有边界 | 保留既定 seeds 的逐次结果；同一数据集内报告模型差异的大小和变化范围。不同数据集/类别数的 ECE 或 Brier 不直接混成一个“整体冠军” |
87	| R1.6 | 正文是否回答了问题 | 清楚说明“哪些 FM、在哪些任务/适配条件下、偏向过度或不足自信、证据多强”，并指出模型排序是否随条件变化 |
88	
89	对 R1.4 的重要定义：
90	“在所有有效像素上，用建筑物概率对比二元建筑物标签”的类概率校准，
91	与“只在真实建筑物像素中统计某种置信度”不是同一个量。
92	沿用现有指标时必须解释其采样条件；不能用含义不清的 foreground ECE 代替定义。
93	
94	RQ1 判为 ANSWERED 的条件：
95	比较块有效、概率指标和诊断图齐备、关键类别没有被总分掩盖、结论与覆盖范围相符。
96	有限样本中“未观察到明显失校准”可以成立；不写成证明全域完美校准。
97	若仅有最终 ECE 数字而不能解释计算对象、分箱或图中偏差，判为 PARTIAL 或 INVALID。
98	
99	## 5. RQ2：不同 fine-tuning 方式怎样影响 calibration？
100	
101	分析对象：同一 FM 和数据集下的 deterministic frozen 与 full 结果。
102	
103	定义差值：
104	ΔECE = ECE_full − ECE_frozen
105	ΔNLL = NLL_full − NLL_frozen
106	ΔBrier = Brier_full − Brier_frozen
107	ΔPerformance = Performance_full − Performance_frozen
108	
109	Performance 是当前任务匹配的性能指标，单标签分类用 accuracy，分割主要看 mIoU/关键类别 IoU。
110	
111	| ID | 具体审查事项 | 足够回答问题所需的证据 |
112	| --- | --- | --- |
113	| R2.1 | 两种适配是否真正实现 | trainable parameter/module 清单、冻结状态及必要的更新验证；冻结 backbone + 训练 head 的措辞与实际一致 |
114	| R2.2 | 是否控制重要混杂因素 | 两组使用相同数据划分、输入信息、目标标签、可比较的 head、增强和评估代码；记录优化器、LR、训练预算、早停及调参依据的差异 |
115	| R2.3 | 是否有明确的配对效果 | 在可以配对的 seed/数据条件下计算差值；不能用 frozen 的最好 seed 对比 full 的均值，也不能只比较两张来源不同的表 |
116	| R2.4 | 是否检查性能与校准共同变化 | 每个比较块同时报告 ΔPerformance 与 ΔECE，并对照 ΔNLL、ΔBrier；说明是共同改善、发生权衡，还是校准变化不稳定 |
117	| R2.5 | 结论是否跨条件成立 | 对已纳入的不同 FM、分类/分割分别汇总一致与反例。一个数据集的方向不能写成所有 EO FM 的普遍规律 |
118	
119	R2.2 的判定：
120	不同适配方式可以使用各自合理的 LR 或训练配方，不要求为了表面一致而强制同一 LR。
121	但这时估计的是“所采用适配方案”的差异。若要声称差异仅由冻结/解冻本身引起，需要额外控制或收窄因果措辞。
122	分类按 val NLL、分割按 val mIoU 选 checkpoint，不因两种任务不同就自动判错；核查各任务内部一致性，并避免把跨任务差异全部归因于任务性质。
123	
124	RQ2 判为 ANSWERED 的条件：
125	可比对照存在、差值有证据、主要混杂因素已控制或披露、性能—校准关系得到直接回答。
126	“full 对 calibration 没有稳定影响”或“影响因任务而异”也是完整答案。
127	
128	## 6. RQ3：UQ 方法能否改善校准，是否牺牲 accuracy？
129	
130	以匹配的 deterministic 基线为参照，逐方法定义：
131	ΔECE = ECE_method − ECE_baseline
132	ΔPerformance = Performance_method − Performance_baseline
133	同时报告 ΔNLL 与 ΔBrier。
134	
135	| ID | 具体审查事项 | 足够回答问题所需的证据 |
136	| --- | --- | --- |
137	| R3.1 | 方法是否有正确对照 | 相同评估样本、指标、mask 和决策规则；清楚记录使用哪个基模型/训练配方。新增 dropout 训练或其他训练变化有相应匹配对照 |
138	| R3.2 | 是否校准在拟合集之外 | TS 等超参拟合不使用最终评估标签；报告拟合目标、数据、参数和最终评估来源。拟合集上变好不能直接回答最终效果 |
139	| R3.3 | TS 是否实现与命名一致 | 标准 TS 使用正的单个温度缩放同一 checkpoint 的 logits。单标签 softmax + argmax 条件下应保持预测类别，因此 accuracy 和同样标签产生的 IoU 应保持；明显变化须定位原因 |
140	| R3.4 | MC Dropout 是否真正随机且可比 | 记录训练时 dropout 及位置/概率、推理时启用模块、采样次数。随机采样实际不同；BatchNorm 等不误更新；以采样预测概率均值计算主指标；使用同权重 dropout-off 对照，必要时另报原始基线 |
141	| R3.5 | Deep Ensemble 是否真为集成预测 | 成员来自独立下游训练，样本/类别对齐，按概率平均后再算主指标。不能把多个成员 ECE 的平均当作 ensemble ECE；同一轨迹的多个 epoch 也不能无说明当作独立 deep ensemble |
142	| R3.6 | 是否同时检验收益与性能代价 | 每个已承诺方法/比较块都有校准指标和任务性能的前后差值；即使“无改善/变差”也完整保留 |
143	| R3.7 | 重复层级是否正确 | 多次 MC forward 不是多个训练 seed；3 个成员组成一个 ensemble 不是 3 个独立 ensemble。若只构建一组 ensemble，可报告该组结果，但不据此宣称跨 ensemble 训练稳定性 |
144	| R3.8 | 是否充分报告反例和指标冲突 | 方法在某些任务有益、另一些无益应如实总结。ECE 降而 NLL/Brier 升时分别报告，不能选择性概括成“所有概率质量都改善” |
145	| R3.9 | 是否清楚回答 accuracy 代价 | 明确每个方法属于下表哪种情况；“p 不显著”不能替代无性能代价的证据。没有预先定义实际容忍幅度时，报告实际差值和区间，谨慎使用“没有损失” |
146	
147	标准 TS 的 argmax 保持性质仅在对应决策规则下适用。多标签 sigmoid + 非 0.5 阈值、类别相关缩放、重选阈值或额外后处理要另行推导，不能无条件套用。
148	接近相同 logits 的浮点误差、平局处理等可导致极少数数值差异；应记录量级与原因，不因此直接触发全量重训。
149	参考：[Guo et al., 2017, temperature scaling](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v70/guo17a/guo17a.pdf)。
150	
151	MC Dropout 和 Deep Ensemble 的身份与概率聚合参考：
152	[Gal & Ghahramani, 2016](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v48/gal16.html)；
153	[Lakshminarayanan et al., 2017](https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2017/file/9ef2ed4b7fd2c810847ffa5fa85bce38-Paper.pdf)。
154	EO FM 的各成员可以共享同一预训练权重起点；“独立训练”主要核查下游训练过程的独立性，不要求重新预训练 FM。
155	
156	方法结果分类：
157	
158	| 观察结果 | 合格表述 |
159	| --- | --- |
160	| 校准改善，性能保持或改善 | 在声明条件下取得校准收益，报告性能差值及其证据 |
161	| 校准改善，性能下降 | 存在性能—校准权衡，量化损失，检查是否集中于关键类别 |
162	| 校准无稳定改善，性能保持 | 此设置中没有稳定观察到额外校准收益 |
163	| 校准无改善且性能下降 | 此设置中方法不利 |
164	| 不同任务/模型结论不同 | 效果依赖具体条件，列出改善与反例 |
165	| 区间过宽或重复不足 | 当前证据不足以确定效应方向或排除实际性能损失，说明能支持的点估计范围 |
166	
167	以上任何结果类别都可能回答 RQ3。数据/实现有效性和结论强度才决定是否通过，不能把“方法没效果”本身列为缺陷。
168	
169	## 7. 针对当前项目的优先核查线索
170	
171	这些是应检查的事项，不是对当前实现存在错误的断言。
172	
173	1. TreeSatAI 的标签任务：
174	   原始档案包含多标签任务。先读取当前 adapter、标签文件与 loss，确认论文是否采用多标签任务，或明确构造了单标签任务。
175	   若多标签，检查 sigmoid/BCE、阈值、label-wise calibration、macro/micro 指标；若单标签，检查转换依据和保留样本。
176	   不直接把历史中的“classification + accuracy + CE”视为必然正确或必然错误。
177	   数据集来源：[Ahlswede et al., 2023](https://essd.copernicus.org/articles/15/681/2023/)。
178	2. TreeSatAI 的 calibration 数据：
179	   追踪 TS 拟合到底用哪些样本及其先前用途。没有独立命名的 calibration split 只是待核查线索，不是全量重训理由。
180	3. SpaceNet7：
181	   检查建筑物 IoU、关键类别概率校准与全像素统计的差异，确认是否由背景占比掩盖。
182	   边界 ECE 仅在现行协议/论文声称涉及边界表现时纳入必需；无边界样本的未定义值要明确统计处理。
183	4. 波段和模型输入：
184	   核对 DOFA 波段顺序/波长和 Panopticon 的输入/特征适配是否与当前配置相符；旧问题若已有与当前版本匹配的充分证据，不重复全部审计。
185	5. checkpoint：
186	   分类 NLL 与分割 mIoU 的既定选择规则，在各自比较中是否一致；论文是否准确写出。
187	6. 历史数值警告及废弃运行：
188	   对已记录的极小浮点 argmax 差异、零 epoch 初始化目录等，检查处理记录与当前版本是否仍有效，避免把已解释现象重新升级为科学缺陷。
189	
190	## 8. Agent 执行与输出格式
191	
192	第一轮以只读审查和必要的低成本指标重算为主。先复用已有证据，不自动启动训练或扩大论文范围。
193	
194	- Codex：建立实际覆盖矩阵；核查配置、样本、checkpoint、指标与结果来源；执行最小必要验证。
195	- Claude Code：独立审查上述比较能否回答三问，识别遗漏对照、混杂因素、指标误解和结论外推；对关键证据做独立抽查。
196	- 双方先各自记录发现，再交叉核对。审查对象使用固定代码版本和结果快照。
197	- 对实质争议要求最小复现/独立重算或明确保留争议。没有新证据时不循环互相改写意见。
198	- 协调者维护唯一问题列表，保留每条发现的接受/驳回依据。
199	- 初次读取完整标准；后续任务引用相关检查 ID 和必要数据，避免反复把全部历史、日志和本文件全文塞进每次交接。
200	
201	每条检查输出以下字段：
202	check_id, rq, model, dataset, adaptation, method, status,
203	evidence_path, run_or_checkpoint_id, code_revision,
204	finding, impact_on_answer, minimal_resolution, owner, acceptance_evidence
205	
206	status 只能使用：
207	- PASS：直接证据支持该检查通过；
208	- FAIL：已证实问题或承诺范围内的缺失；
209	- UNKNOWN：当前证据不够或没有检查；
210	- NA：不适用，必须有理由。
211	
212	每个 RQ 的结论状态：
213	- ANSWERED：本 RQ 范围内的关键比较有效，证据充分，结论表述与证据一致；
214	- PARTIAL：只回答部分声明范围，或仍有重要不确定性；
215	- INVALID：关键证据受泄漏、实现或不可比对照影响；
216	- UNASSESSED：尚未完成审查。
217	
218	不采用“总分 90% 即通过”。一个与主结论直接相关的 FAIL 可以使对应结论无效。
219	非关键 UNKNOWN 不自动使所有研究结果无效，应标清影响范围。
220	不把一个实验错误自动扩大成全论文失败；先定位受影响的 run 和主张。
221	
222	最终至少交付：
223	
224	A. 覆盖表：已声明 vs 实际模型/数据/适配/方法/seed，以及缺失原因。
225	B. 三问证据表：每个 RQ 的直接答案草稿、证据位置、适用范围、状态和阻塞项。
226	C. 问题清单：使用检查 ID，逐条指出遗漏/不合理及其对答案的影响。
227	D. 必需后续任务：区分修复实现、已有结果重分析、补评估、新训练、修改表述；每项写明验收条件。
228	
229	只在以下情况提出新训练：
230	- 现有训练受到已确认的实现/数据问题影响，无法只修复评估；
231	- 已承诺的核心对照缺失，且现有 checkpoint 不能回答；
232	- 核心结论的证据不足，新增独立训练是最小且合理的补充。
233	
234	在建议补实验前说明：它对应哪个 RQ/检查 ID，现有证据为何不足，是否可用已有 logits/checkpoint 解决，以及不同结果怎样改变论文答案。

1	# Pre-UQ Protocol Freeze — Final Version
2	
3	**Freeze date:** 2026-08-25  
4	**Status:** FINAL for the thesis experiments covered here  
5	**Scope:** future MC Dropout work and final reporting; no deterministic artifact is changed
6	
7	## Executive decision
8	
9	The completed deterministic benchmark remains valid. The checkpoint-sensitivity audit found substantial counterfactual changes in some runs, but it did **not** identify a severe scientific defect in the historical validation-only policies. The observed pattern is scientifically interpretable: classification NLL selection favors probabilistic fit, whereas segmentation mIoU selection protects task performance and, on SpaceNet7, avoids background-dominated early checkpoints with almost no useful building segmentation.
10	
11	The final policy is therefore:
12	
13	| Experiment family | Frozen checkpoint criterion |
14	|---|---|
15	| Classification deterministic | Minimum validation NLL |
16	| Classification MC Dropout | Minimum validation NLL |
17	| Segmentation deterministic | Maximum validation mIoU |
18	| Segmentation MC Dropout | Maximum validation mIoU |
19	
20	Ties use the earliest epoch. Checkpoint selection is validation-only. Test labels, test metrics, MC uncertainty results, and downstream calibration results must never be used to select or revisit a checkpoint.
21	
22	**No completed deterministic experiment requires retraining, repeat inference, or checkpoint replacement.** The checkpoint audit is not a blocker to within-task UQ work. It is a blocker to strong causal interpretation of raw classification-versus-segmentation calibration differences, so those claims are prohibited below.
23	
24	No MC Dropout training is authorized by the creation of this report itself, and none was started during this freeze.
25	
26	## Evidence reviewed and precedence
27	
28	This decision was made after reviewing the available final and historical evidence, including:
29	
30	- `reports/checkpoint_selection_sensitivity.md`;
31	- the final C1 deterministic completion report and all C1 promotion-audit reports;
32	- the C2 execution/completion record and all C2 promotion-audit reports, including the final 24/24 promotion audit;
33	- `reports/c3_temperature_scaling_and_ensembles.md`, `reports/c3_treesatai_temperature_scaling.md`, and the C3 classification and segmentation result tables;
34	- the frozen dataset/training protocols for EuroSAT, TreeSatAI, CloudSEN12, and SpaceNet7; and
35	- `reports/code_audit.md` and the current MC collection/model code.
36	
37	Where an earlier report conflicts with this document on a reporting choice, this dated freeze takes precedence. Earlier artifacts remain immutable provenance. In particular, the existing TreeSatAI validation-fitted Temperature Scaling artifacts are retained as historical/diagnostic artifacts but are excluded from final thesis results under the rule below.
38	
39	The early repository-wide code audit predates completion of much of the deterministic matrix. Its old completion counts are superseded by the final C1/C2 audits, while its methodological warning that standard MC Dropout requires training-time non-zero dropout remains applicable.
40	
41	## 1. Checkpoint-selection policy
42	
43	### 1.1 Interpretation of the sensitivity audit
44	
45	The audit reconstructed validation-level alternative selection for all 48 promoted deterministic runs without retraining or inference. It found:
46	
47	- a changed epoch in 43/48 runs;
48	- 26/48 MATERIAL or SEVERE ratings under its descriptive per-run rubric;
49	- 20/24 changed classification epochs, with the six TreeSatAI full-finetune task-metric alternatives rated SEVERE; and
50	- 23/24 changed segmentation epochs, with systematic SpaceNet7 sensitivity and all pixel-NLL minima occurring at epochs 1–3.
51	
52	A per-run **SEVERE sensitivity rating is not, by itself, a severe scientific defect**. It says that a counterfactual policy would select a meaningfully different operating point. Here the direction of the changes supports the task-specific policy rather than invalidating it:
53	
54	- TreeSatAI full-finetune Macro-F1 maxima occur later but have very large NLL and ECE increases. Minimum NLL is consistent with the predeclared classification objective and avoids the documented post-best probabilistic instability.
55	- SpaceNet7 minimum pixel-NLL checkpoints gain background-dominated aggregate likelihood/accuracy while sharply reducing building IoU. Selecting them would make the nominally uniform probabilistic rule scientifically misleading for the foreground task.
56	- Every retained selector is validation-only, and the final C1 and C2 promotion audits found no artifact defect that invalidates a promoted checkpoint.
57	
58	Accordingly, there is no checkpoint-selection blocker for within-task deterministic-versus-MC comparisons. The material confound applies to absolute cross-task calibration interpretation and is handled by the claim restrictions in Section 6.
59	
60	### 1.2 Locked use of checkpoints
61	
62	- Historical deterministic `best.pt` artifacts remain authoritative and must not be replaced or relabeled.
63	- Future MC Dropout models are new dropout-enabled training runs. They start from the same official pretrained foundation weights and a fresh downstream head/decoder under the corresponding deterministic cell protocol; an existing dropout-zero deterministic checkpoint must not be converted into an MC model by changing dropout only at inference.
64	- Classification MC Dropout validation uses minimum NLL; segmentation MC Dropout validation uses maximum mIoU. Dropout is disabled during validation used for checkpoint selection, making the selector deterministic and directly aligned with its deterministic comparator.
65	- Within a task, deterministic and MC Dropout comparisons therefore share the same split, primary preprocessing/training protocol, and selection principle. The intended dropout mechanism is the experimental difference.
66	- Historical counterfactual epochs that were not retained must not be recreated. The sensitivity values remain an audit result, not a request for retroactive checkpoints.
67	
68	## 2. Temperature Scaling policy
69	
70	### 2.1 TreeSatAI
71

90	
91	Every deterministic, MC Dropout, and applicable ensemble SpaceNet7 result must report at least the following, using the same valid-pixel/ignore mask and the fixed calibration-bin convention:
92	
93	| Required quantity | Frozen interpretation |
94	|---|---|
95	| Overall pixel ECE | Top-label ECE across all valid pixels |
96	| Foreground/building ECE | Binary calibration of building probability against the building indicator |
97	| Classwise calibration | One-vs-rest calibration for both `background` and `building`; do not report only their average |
98	| Foreground NLL | Binary building-vs-not-building NLL over valid pixels |

100	| Boundary ECE | Top-label ECE on valid boundary pixels; boundary foreground ECE should also be retained/reported when available |

102	Boundary handling is immutable:
103	
104	- A per-image boundary ECE with zero valid boundary pixels is `NaN`/undefined.
105	- It must never be replaced with zero, because zero would falsely encode perfect calibration.
106	- Per-image summaries exclude undefined values and report the number of images contributing a valid boundary value.
107	- Dataset-level boundary ECE is computed by pooling calibration-bin counts/confidence/outcomes from **valid boundary pixels only**. It is not an unweighted mean of per-image ECE values, and zero-boundary images contribute no pixels.
108	- Ignore-index pixels never enter the boundary or non-boundary calibration denominators.

123	## 5. MC Dropout method and compute freeze
124	
125	### 5.1 Method contract
126	
127	The following prospective choices are fixed before any MC Dropout training so that the method cannot be tuned after seeing UQ or test results:
128	
129	- **Training-time dropout is mandatory.** Inference-only alteration of a deterministic dropout-zero checkpoint is prohibited.
130	- **Dropout rate:** `p = 0.10` for every cell.
131	- **Classification placement:** one standard dropout layer immediately before the final linear classifier (after the fixed BatchNorm in the EuroSAT head, and before the linear layer in the TreeSatAI head).
132	- **Segmentation placement:** one channelwise spatial dropout (`Dropout2d`) on the common decoder's final feature map, immediately before the 1×1 classifier.
133	- **Backbone stochasticity:** do not enable or alter foundation-backbone dropout, DropPath, or stochastic depth. This keeps the intervention identical across DOFA and Panopticon and makes the method specifically downstream-head/decoder MC Dropout.
134	- **Checkpoint validation:** ordinary evaluation mode with dropout disabled; apply the task-specific criterion in Section 1.
135	- **MC inference:** exactly 30 stochastic forward passes per sample. Keep the full model in evaluation mode except for the single designated dropout module, so BatchNorm and other normalization/statistics remain fixed.
136	- **Aggregation:** arithmetic mean of per-pass probabilities is the predictive probability. Do not average class decisions or logits as the primary MC prediction.
137	- **Uncertainty decomposition:** retain raw per-pass probabilities and compute predictive entropy, expected entropy, mutual information, and probability variance at the natural output unit (per label for TreeSatAI and per pixel for segmentation) before any documented summary reduction. MC passes are repeated draws, not independent training seeds.
138	- **No adaptive tuning:** dropout rate, placement, pass count, seed set, replication subset, and checkpoint may not be changed in response to validation calibration, test performance, or attractive uncertainty maps.
139	
140	This contract intentionally uses only the shared downstream module. It avoids a model-family confound from different native backbone dropout/DropPath implementations and must be described in the thesis as **head/decoder MC Dropout**, not as full-backbone Bayesian inference.
141	
142	The existing generic `samples: 10` entry and commented historical examples are not authoritative. This freeze supersedes them for the final MC experiments. Implementing this prospective path may add new MC-specific configuration/code, but it must not modify existing model artifacts or reinterpret deterministic checkpoints.
143	
144	### 5.2 Minimum scientifically defensible replication
145	
146	The core design is **24 new MC Dropout training runs**, not 48:
147	
148	1. Run one predeclared training seed, **seed 42**, for every model × dataset × adaptation cell: 16 runs.
149	2. Pair each result with the completed deterministic run from seed 42 in the identical cell. The primary per-cell contrast is therefore seed-matched.
150	3. Add seeds 43 and 44 in the following four predeclared robustness cells: 8 additional runs.

153	|---|---|---|---|---|
154	| EuroSAT | DOFA | frozen | 42, 43, 44 | Stable multiclass classification reference |
155	| TreeSatAI | Panopticon | full fine-tune | 42, 43, 44 | Multilabel classification and a sensitive full-finetune regime |
156	| CloudSEN12 | Panopticon | frozen | 42, 43, 44 | Four-class segmentation with frozen transfer |
157	| SpaceNet7 | DOFA | full fine-tune | 42, 43, 44 | Imbalanced foreground segmentation and a sensitive full-finetune regime |

160	
161	Reporting rules for this design:
162	
163	- For all 16 cells, report the seed-42 deterministic-versus-MC paired difference.
164	- For the four robustness cells, additionally report the three seed-level paired differences and their mean and standard deviation. Do not treat 30 MC passes as `n = 30` independent replicates.
165	- Use the three deterministic seeds and the already completed Deep Ensemble as complementary evidence about training-seed and ensemble uncertainty, but do not present the three-member Deep Ensemble versus one-seed MC contrast as a controlled causal comparison.

167	- The subset cannot be changed after inspecting MC results. An unfavorable or favorable seed-42 result is not a reason to add seeds selectively.

94	## 7. Validation-only learning-rate contingency
95	
96	Default action is **no LR tuning**. A lower validation score than the other model is not a reason to tune. The contingency below may be opened only for objective optimizer instability—non-finite loss/gradients, repeat divergence, or failure to produce a valid validation checkpoint—documented before any test access.
97	
98	EuroSAT is excluded from model-specific tuning because its DOFA comparator is already immutable. Panopticon uses the table's inherited settings. If those settings are objectively unstable, the EuroSAT comparison is paused and requires a protocol amendment; the DOFA artifacts remain untouched.
99	
100	For TreeSatAI, CloudSEN12, or SpaceNet7, an affected dataset × adaptation pair receives exactly the same tuning budget for DOFA and Panopticon:
101	
102	1. Three pilot attempts per model, all with seed 42 and the frozen batch/preprocessing protocol.
103	2. LR multipliers `{1/3, 1, 3}` applied to every active LR group while preserving the backbone-to-head/decoder ratio.
104	3. Exactly 10 epochs per attempt, with no early termination and no replacement attempt if a candidate fails.
105	4. No test dataloader, test metric, test prediction, or test export is permitted. Pilot outputs are labelled `PILOT_ONLY` and cannot become ensemble members or final checkpoints.
106	5. Select each model's multiplier by its best validation NLL (classification) or best validation mIoU (segmentation) within the 10 epochs. An exact tie prefers multiplier `1`, then `1/3`, then `3`.
107	6. Record the complete candidate table, including failed candidates. Then train fresh final runs for seeds 42, 43, and 44 with the selected setting.
108	
109	No additional candidates, seeds, epochs, or post-test adjustments are allowed. Opening this contingency for one model automatically spends the same three-attempt budget on the other model in that dataset × adaptation pair.

2	
3	Created: 2026-08-25T22:48:06.191548+00:00
4	
5	Status: frozen prospectively from `reports/pre_uq_protocol_freeze.md`.
6	
7	## Method scope
8	
9	The thesis method is **downstream-head/decoder MC Dropout**. DOFA and Panopticon backbone architectures, native dropout, DropPath, and stochastic depth are not altered or enabled. Classification uses one `Dropout(p=0.10)` immediately before the final linear classifier (after EuroSAT's fixed BatchNorm). Segmentation uses one `Dropout2d(p=0.10)` on the common decoder's final feature map immediately before its 1×1 classifier. Placement is identical across backbone families within each task.
10	
11	The deterministic comparator retains its original zero-dropout head/decoder. The MC model is newly trained with the one designated dropout layer; a deterministic checkpoint is never converted by inference-only dropout insertion.
12	
13	## Training and checkpoint selection
14	
15	- Classification: minimum validation NLL; earliest strict tie.
16	- Segmentation: maximum validation mIoU; earliest strict tie.
17	- Validation used for checkpoint selection is deterministic with dropout disabled.
18	- Test metrics, calibration, and uncertainty never participate in selection.
19	
20	## Stochastic inference
21	
22	- Freeze model weights; call full-model evaluation mode, then activate exactly the one designated downstream dropout module.
23	- BatchNorm remains in evaluation mode and its running buffers must be unchanged.
24	- Use `torch.no_grad()` and identical preprocessed input tensors for all passes.
25	- Run exactly `T=30` passes for final experiments. Arithmetic-mean probabilities—not logits or decisions—are predictive probabilities.
26	- Preserve predictive entropy, expected entropy, their difference as MI-style disagreement, and per-class/per-pixel probability variance.
27	
28	## Pass-count validation rule
29	
30	Pilots evaluate nested prefixes T=10/20/30/50 on validation only. T=30 is accepted relative to T=50 only when probability MAE ≤0.005, maximum absolute probability difference ≤0.05, each requested metric changes by ≤0.01, and each mean uncertainty summary changes by ≤0.01. Failure blocks the full launch; thresholds are not adjusted after results.
31	
32	## Output schema
33	
34	Classification saves `[N,T,C]` raw logits/probabilities plus sample ID, label, probability-mean prediction, predictive entropy, expected entropy, MI-style disagreement, probability variance `[N,C]`, and backbone representation.
35	
36	Segmentation saves full-test probability-mean maps, prediction/confidence maps, predictive entropy, expected entropy, disagreement, and variance. Full `[N_subset,T,C,H,W]` stochastic probabilities are retained only for the predeclared research subset when full storage is excessive. The exact final CloudSEN12 and SpaceNet7 test IDs were fixed by label/prediction-independent SHA256 ranking before pilot stochastic inference in `reports/mc_dropout_segmentation_research_subset_ids.json`.
37	
38	## Replication
39	
40	The frozen core is 24 new runs: seed 42 for all 16 cells, plus seeds 43/44 only for EuroSAT/DOFA/frozen, TreeSatAI/Panopticon/full-finetune, CloudSEN12/Panopticon/frozen, and SpaceNet7/DOFA/full-finetune. MC passes are repeated posterior-style draws, not independent training replicates.

135	## Applicability and caveats
136	
137	- All 8 classification cells have deterministic, Temperature Scaling, MC Dropout, and Deep Ensemble results.
138	- All 8 segmentation cells have deterministic, MC Dropout, and Deep Ensemble results; Temperature Scaling is N/A by design.
139	- SpaceNet7 boundary calibration uses valid boundary pixels only. Boundary-free per-image values remain undefined in the underlying archives.
140	- The C3 segmentation ensemble summary CSV omitted SpaceNet7 classwise-ECE columns. This package restores the already-computed values from each validated ensemble manifest; no new inference or metric estimation was performed.
141	- EuroSAT retains a frozen backend-specific preprocessing history: immutable DOFA comparators use their historical RGB normalization, whereas Panopticon uses the newer final train-statistics convention. Cross-model EuroSAT comparisons must retain this confound disclosure.
142	- Some full-finetuning learning curves deteriorate after the validation-selected optimum; final rows use only the frozen validation-selected best checkpoints.

47	def stable_probabilities(logits: torch.Tensor, classification_type: str = "multiclass") -> torch.Tensor:
48	    logits = logits.detach().float().cpu()
49	    if not torch.isfinite(logits).all():
50	        raise ValueError("Logits contain NaN or Inf")
51	    if classification_type == "multiclass":
52	        return torch.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1).exp()
53	    if classification_type == "multilabel":
54	        return torch.sigmoid(logits)
55	    raise ValueError("classification_type must be multiclass or multilabel")

62	def _prediction_summaries(
63	    probabilities: np.ndarray,
64	    classification_type: str = "multiclass",
65	    threshold: float = 0.5,
66	) -> Dict[str, np.ndarray]:
67	    if probabilities.ndim != 2:
68	        raise ValueError(f"Expected [samples, classes] probabilities, got {probabilities.shape}")
69	    safe = np.clip(probabilities.astype(np.float64), np.finfo(np.float64).tiny, 1.0)
70	    if classification_type == "multilabel":
71	        predicted = (probabilities >= threshold).astype(np.int8)
72	        confidence = np.maximum(probabilities, 1.0 - probabilities).mean(axis=1)
73	        entropy = -(
74	            probabilities.astype(np.float64) * np.log(safe)
75	            + (1.0 - probabilities.astype(np.float64))
76	            * np.log(np.clip(1.0 - probabilities.astype(np.float64), np.finfo(np.float64).tiny, 1.0))
77	        ).sum(axis=1)
78	        return {
79	            "predicted": predicted,
80	            "maximum": confidence.astype(np.float32),
81	            "margin": (2.0 * np.abs(probabilities - 0.5)).mean(axis=1).astype(np.float32),
82	            "entropy": entropy.astype(np.float32),
83	        }
84	    if classification_type != "multiclass":
85	        raise ValueError("classification_type must be multiclass or multilabel")
86	    order = np.argsort(probabilities, axis=1)
87	    predicted = order[:, -1].astype(np.int64)
88	    top1 = probabilities[np.arange(len(probabilities)), order[:, -1]]
89	    top2 = probabilities[np.arange(len(probabilities)), order[:, -2]] if probabilities.shape[1] > 1 else np.zeros_like(top1)
90	    entropy = -(probabilities.astype(np.float64) * np.log(safe)).sum(axis=1)
91	    return {
92	        "predicted": predicted,
93	        "maximum": top1.astype(np.float32),
94	        "margin": (top1 - top2).astype(np.float32),
95	        "entropy": entropy.astype(np.float32),
96	    }

332	def export_stochastic_predictions(
333	    output_dir: str | Path,
334	    *,
335	    stochastic_logits: np.ndarray | torch.Tensor,
336	    **metadata: Any,
337	) -> Dict[str, Path]:
338	    """Export MC Dropout/ensemble members without discarding any raw member output."""
339	    raw_logits = torch.as_tensor(stochastic_logits).detach().float().cpu()
340	    if raw_logits.ndim != 3:
341	        raise ValueError("stochastic_logits must have shape [samples, passes_or_members, classes]")
342	    classification_type = str(metadata.get("classification_type", "multiclass"))
343	    member_probabilities = stable_probabilities(raw_logits, classification_type=classification_type)
344	    mean_probabilities = member_probabilities.mean(dim=1)
345	    if classification_type == "multiclass":
346	        aggregate_logits = mean_probabilities.clamp_min(torch.finfo(mean_probabilities.dtype).tiny).log()
347	    elif classification_type == "multilabel":
348	        eps = torch.finfo(mean_probabilities.dtype).eps
349	        clipped = mean_probabilities.clamp(eps, 1.0 - eps)
350	        aggregate_logits = torch.logit(clipped)
351	    else:
352	        raise ValueError("classification_type must be multiclass or multilabel")
353	    return export_predictions(
354	        output_dir,
355	        logits=aggregate_logits,
356	        stochastic_logits=raw_logits,
357	        **metadata,
358	    )

379	    bundle = load_prediction_export(output_dir)
380	    table = bundle.table
381	    schema_version = int(bundle.manifest.get("schema_version", 1))
382	    required_columns = (
383	        {
384	            "sample_id",
385	            "label",
386	            "logits",
387	            "probabilities",
388	            "prediction",
389	            "correctness",
390	            "confidence",
391	            "predictive_entropy",
392	            "backbone_representation",
393	        }
394	        if schema_version >= 2
395	        else {
396	            "sample_id",
397	            "true_label",
398	            "logits",
399	            "probabilities",
400	            "predicted_label",
401	            "correct",
402	            "maximum_softmax_probability",
403	            "predictive_entropy",
404	        }
405	    )
406	    errors: List[str] = []
407	    missing_columns = sorted(required_columns - set(table.columns))
408	    if missing_columns:
409	        errors.append(f"required prediction columns are missing: {missing_columns}")
410	        return {
411	            "valid": False,
412	            "errors": errors,
413	            "sample_count": len(table),
414	            "sample_ids_unique": not table["sample_id"].duplicated().any() if "sample_id" in table else False,
415	            "probability_sum_max_abs_error": None,
416	            "argmax_matches": None,
417	            "finite": False,
418	            "stochastic_shape": None,
419	            "embedding_shape": None,
420	        }
421	    classification_type = str(bundle.manifest.get("classification_type", "multiclass"))
422	    threshold = float(bundle.manifest.get("multilabel_threshold") or 0.5)
423	    label_column_name = "label" if "label" in table else "true_label"
424	    prediction_column_name = "prediction" if "prediction" in table else "predicted_label"
425	    correctness_column_name = "correctness" if "correctness" in table else "correct"
426	    confidence_column_name = "confidence" if "confidence" in table else "maximum_softmax_probability"
427	    logits = _to_matrix(table["logits"])
428	    probabilities = _to_matrix(table["probabilities"])
429	    labels = (
430	        table[label_column_name].to_numpy(dtype=np.int64)
431	        if classification_type == "multiclass"
432	        else _to_matrix(table[label_column_name], dtype=np.int64)
433	    )
434	    predictions = (
435	        table[prediction_column_name].to_numpy(dtype=np.int64)
436	        if classification_type == "multiclass"
437	        else _to_matrix(table[prediction_column_name], dtype=np.int64)
438	    )
439	    representations = _to_matrix(table["backbone_representation"]) if schema_version >= 2 else None
440	    if table["sample_id"].duplicated().any():
441	        errors.append("sample_id is not unique")
442	    target_count = expected_count if expected_count is not None else bundle.manifest.get("expected_count")
443	    if target_count is not None and len(table) != int(target_count):
444	        errors.append(f"sample count {len(table)} != expected {target_count}")
445	    if not np.isfinite(logits).all() or not np.isfinite(probabilities).all():
446	        errors.append("main arrays contain NaN or Inf")
447	    probabilities_from_logits = stable_probabilities(
448	        torch.from_numpy(logits), classification_type=classification_type
449	    ).numpy()
450	    if not np.allclose(probabilities, probabilities_from_logits, atol=probability_tolerance, rtol=0):
451	        errors.append("saved probabilities do not match the configured logits transform")
452	    probability_sums = probabilities.sum(axis=1)
453	    if classification_type == "multiclass":
454	        if not np.allclose(probability_sums, 1.0, atol=probability_tolerance, rtol=0):
455	            errors.append("probability rows do not sum to one")
456	    elif not np.logical_and(probabilities >= 0.0, probabilities <= 1.0).all():
457	        errors.append("multilabel probabilities are outside [0, 1]")
458	    summaries = _prediction_summaries(probabilities, classification_type, threshold)
459	    if not np.array_equal(summaries["predicted"], predictions):
460	        errors.append("probabilities do not match prediction")
461	    if not np.allclose(summaries["maximum"], table[confidence_column_name], atol=probability_tolerance):
462	        errors.append("confidence is inconsistent")
463	    if "top1_top2_probability_margin" in table and not np.allclose(
464	        summaries["margin"], table["top1_top2_probability_margin"], atol=probability_tolerance
465	    ):
466	        errors.append("top1_top2_probability_margin is inconsistent")
467	    if not np.allclose(summaries["entropy"], table["predictive_entropy"], atol=probability_tolerance):
468	        errors.append("predictive_entropy is inconsistent")
469	    expected_correctness = predictions == labels
470	    if classification_type == "multilabel":
471	        expected_correctness = expected_correctness.all(axis=1)
472	    if not np.array_equal(table[correctness_column_name].to_numpy(dtype=bool), expected_correctness):
473	        errors.append("correctness is inconsistent")
474	    if representations is not None and not np.isfinite(representations).all():
475	        errors.append("backbone representations contain NaN or Inf")
476	    if bundle.stochastic is not None:
477	        raw_logits = bundle.stochastic["logits"]
478	        raw_probabilities = bundle.stochastic["probabilities"]
479	        if raw_logits.ndim != 3 or raw_probabilities.shape != raw_logits.shape:
480	            errors.append("stochastic arrays do not have matching [samples, passes_or_members, classes] shapes")
481	        if raw_logits.shape[0] != len(table):
482	            errors.append("stochastic sample dimension does not match main table")
483	        if not np.isfinite(raw_logits).all() or not np.isfinite(raw_probabilities).all():
484	            errors.append("stochastic arrays contain NaN or Inf")
485	        if classification_type == "multiclass" and not np.allclose(
486	            raw_probabilities.sum(axis=-1), 1.0, atol=probability_tolerance, rtol=0
487	        ):
488	            errors.append("stochastic probability rows do not sum to one")
489	        if not np.array_equal(bundle.stochastic["sample_ids"].astype(str), table["sample_id"].astype(str).to_numpy()):
490	            errors.append("stochastic sample_id order differs from main table")
491	        if not np.allclose(raw_probabilities.mean(axis=1), probabilities, atol=probability_tolerance, rtol=0):
492	            errors.append("main probabilities do not equal mean stochastic probabilities")
493	    if bundle.embeddings is not None:
494	        if bundle.embeddings["embeddings"].shape[0] != len(table):
495	            errors.append("embedding sample dimension does not match main table")
496	        if not np.array_equal(bundle.embeddings["sample_ids"].astype(str), table["sample_id"].astype(str).to_numpy()):
497	            errors.append("embedding sample_id order differs from main table")
498	        if not np.isfinite(bundle.embeddings["embeddings"]).all():
499	            errors.append("embeddings contain NaN or Inf")
500	        if representations is not None and not np.allclose(
501	            bundle.embeddings["embeddings"], representations, atol=0.0, rtol=0.0
502	        ):
503	            errors.append("backbone representation column differs from embeddings.npz")
504	    elif schema_version >= 2:
505	        errors.append("backbone representation sidecar is missing")
506	    return {
507	        "valid": not errors,
508	        "errors": errors,
509	        "sample_count": len(table),
510	        "sample_ids_unique": not table["sample_id"].duplicated().any(),
511	        "classification_type": classification_type,
512	        "schema_version": schema_version,
513	        "probability_sum_max_abs_error": (
514	            float(np.max(np.abs(probability_sums - 1.0)))
515	            if len(table) and classification_type == "multiclass"
516	            else None
517	        ),
518	        "argmax_matches": (
519	            "probabilities do not match prediction" not in errors if classification_type == "multiclass" else None
520	        ),
521	        "finite": not any("NaN or Inf" in error for error in errors),
522	        "stochastic_shape": list(bundle.stochastic["logits"].shape) if bundle.stochastic is not None else None,
523	        "embedding_shape": list(bundle.embeddings["embeddings"].shape) if bundle.embeddings is not None else None,
524	    }

527	def recompute_metrics(output_dir: str | Path, n_bins: int = 15) -> Dict[str, Any]:
528	    bundle = load_prediction_export(output_dir)
529	    table = bundle.table
530	    probabilities = _to_matrix(table["probabilities"], dtype=np.float64)
531	    classification_type = str(bundle.manifest.get("classification_type", "multiclass"))
532	    threshold = float(bundle.manifest.get("multilabel_threshold") or 0.5)
533	    label_column_name = "label" if "label" in table else "true_label"
534	    if classification_type == "multilabel":
535	        labels = _to_matrix(table[label_column_name], dtype=np.int64)
536	        predictions = (probabilities >= threshold).astype(np.int64)
537	        accuracy = float(np.mean(np.all(predictions == labels, axis=1)))
538	        clipped = np.clip(probabilities, np.finfo(np.float64).tiny, 1.0 - np.finfo(np.float32).eps)
539	        nll = float(-(labels * np.log(clipped) + (1 - labels) * np.log(1 - clipped)).mean())
540	        brier = float(np.square(probabilities - labels).mean())
541	        decision_confidence = np.maximum(probabilities, 1.0 - probabilities).reshape(-1)
542	        decision_correct = (predictions == labels).reshape(-1)
543	        edges = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, n_bins + 1)
544	        ece = 0.0
545	        for index, (lower, upper) in enumerate(zip(edges[:-1], edges[1:])):
546	            mask = (decision_confidence >= lower if index == 0 else decision_confidence > lower) & (
547	                decision_confidence <= upper
548	            )
549	            if mask.any():
550	                ece += abs(
551	                    float(decision_correct[mask].mean()) - float(decision_confidence[mask].mean())
552	                ) * float(mask.mean())
553	        per_class = []
554	        confusion = []
555	        for class_index, class_name in enumerate(bundle.manifest["class_names"]):
556	            target = labels[:, class_index]
557	            prediction = predictions[:, class_index]
558	            tp = int(np.sum((target == 1) & (prediction == 1)))
559	            fp = int(np.sum((target == 0) & (prediction == 1)))
560	            fn = int(np.sum((target == 1) & (prediction == 0)))
561	            tn = int(np.sum((target == 0) & (prediction == 0)))
562	            precision = tp / (tp + fp) if tp + fp else 0.0
563	            recall = tp / (tp + fn) if tp + fn else 0.0
564	            f1 = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall) if precision + recall else 0.0
565	            confusion.append([[tn, fp], [fn, tp]])
566	            per_class.append(
567	                {
568	                    "class_index": class_index,
569	                    "class_name": class_name,
570	                    "precision": float(precision),
571	                    "recall": float(recall),
572	                    "f1": float(f1),
573	                    "support": int(target.sum()),
574	                    "tn": tn,
575	                    "fp": fp,
576	                    "fn": fn,
577	                    "tp": tp,
578	                }
579	            )
580	        entropy = -(
581	            probabilities * np.log(clipped) + (1.0 - probabilities) * np.log(1.0 - clipped)
582	        ).sum(axis=1)
583	        return {
584	            "classification_type": classification_type,
585	            "accuracy": accuracy,
586	            "labelwise_accuracy": float(np.mean(predictions == labels)),
587	            "macro_f1": float(np.mean([item["f1"] for item in per_class])),
588	            "nll": nll,
589	            "brier": brier,
590	            "ece": ece,
591	            "mean_confidence": float(decision_confidence.mean()),
592	            "mean_predictive_entropy": float(entropy.mean()),
593	            "per_class": per_class,
594	            "confusion_matrix": confusion,
595	        }
596	
597	    labels = table[label_column_name].to_numpy(dtype=np.int64)
598	    predictions = probabilities.argmax(axis=1)
599	    accuracy = float(np.mean(predictions == labels))
600	    selected = np.clip(probabilities[np.arange(len(labels)), labels], np.finfo(np.float64).tiny, 1.0)
601	    nll = float(-np.log(selected).mean())
602	    targets = np.eye(probabilities.shape[1], dtype=np.float64)[labels]
603	    brier = float(np.square(probabilities - targets).sum(axis=1).mean())
604	    confidence = probabilities.max(axis=1)
605	    correct = predictions == labels
606	    edges = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, n_bins + 1)
607	    ece = 0.0
608	    for index, (lower, upper) in enumerate(zip(edges[:-1], edges[1:])):
609	        mask = (confidence >= lower if index == 0 else confidence > lower) & (confidence <= upper)
610	        if mask.any():
611	            ece += abs(float(correct[mask].mean()) - float(confidence[mask].mean())) * float(mask.mean())
612	    confusion = np.zeros((probabilities.shape[1], probabilities.shape[1]), dtype=np.int64)
613	    np.add.at(confusion, (labels, predictions), 1)
614	    per_class = []
615	    for class_index in range(probabilities.shape[1]):
616	        true_positive = int(confusion[class_index, class_index])
617	        predicted_count = int(confusion[:, class_index].sum())
618	        support = int(confusion[class_index, :].sum())
619	        precision = true_positive / predicted_count if predicted_count else 0.0
620	        recall = true_positive / support if support else 0.0
621	        denominator = precision + recall
622	        f1 = 2 * precision * recall / denominator if denominator else 0.0
623	        per_class.append(
624	            {
625	                "class_index": class_index,
626	                "class_name": bundle.manifest["class_names"][class_index],
627	                "precision": float(precision),
628	                "recall": float(recall),
629	                "f1": float(f1),
630	                "support": support,
631	            }
632	        )
633	    safe_probabilities = np.clip(probabilities, np.finfo(np.float64).tiny, 1.0)
634	    entropy = -(probabilities * np.log(safe_probabilities)).sum(axis=1)
635	    return {
636	        "classification_type": classification_type,
637	        "accuracy": accuracy,
638	        "macro_f1": float(np.mean([item["f1"] for item in per_class])),
639	        "nll": nll,
640	        "brier": brier,
641	        "ece": ece,
642	        "mean_confidence": float(confidence.mean()),
643	        "mean_predictive_entropy": float(entropy.mean()),
644	        "per_class": per_class,
645	        "confusion_matrix": confusion.tolist(),
646	    }

677	def collect_deterministic_predictions(
678	    model: torch.nn.Module,
679	    loader: DataLoader,
680	    device: torch.device,
681	    *,
682	    limit_batches: Optional[int] = None,
683	    embedding_extractor: Optional[Callable[[torch.Tensor], torch.Tensor]] = None,
684	) -> Dict[str, Any]:
685	    model.eval()
686	    sample_ids: List[str] = []
687	    labels: List[torch.Tensor] = []
688	    logits: List[torch.Tensor] = []
689	    embeddings: List[torch.Tensor] = []
690	    for batch_index, batch in enumerate(loader):
691	        if limit_batches is not None and batch_index >= limit_batches:
692	            break
693	        if "sample_id" not in batch:
694	            raise ValueError("Prediction export requires sample_id in every DataLoader batch")
695	        images = batch["image"].to(device)
696	        sample_ids.extend(str(value) for value in batch["sample_id"])
697	        labels.append(batch["label"].cpu())
698	        temporal_mask = batch.get("temporal_mask")
699	        if temporal_mask is not None:
700	            temporal_mask = temporal_mask.to(device)
701	            logits.append(model(images, temporal_mask=temporal_mask).cpu())
702	        else:
703	            logits.append(model(images).cpu())
704	        if embedding_extractor is not None:
705	            if temporal_mask is not None:
706	                embeddings.append(embedding_extractor(images, temporal_mask=temporal_mask).detach().cpu())
707	            else:
708	                embeddings.append(embedding_extractor(images).detach().cpu())
709	    if not logits:
710	        raise ValueError("Prediction loader produced no batches")
711	    if len(set(sample_ids)) != len(sample_ids):
712	        raise ValueError("Prediction DataLoader produced duplicate sample_id values")
713	    return {
714	        "sample_ids": sample_ids,
715	        "labels": torch.cat(labels),
716	        "logits": torch.cat(logits),
717	        "embeddings": torch.cat(embeddings) if embeddings else None,
718	    }

735	def _collect_prediction_pass(
736	    model: torch.nn.Module, loader: DataLoader, device: torch.device, limit_batches: Optional[int]
737	) -> Dict[str, Any]:
738	    sample_ids: List[str] = []
739	    labels: List[torch.Tensor] = []
740	    logits: List[torch.Tensor] = []
741	    for batch_index, batch in enumerate(loader):
742	        if limit_batches is not None and batch_index >= limit_batches:
743	            break
744	        if "sample_id" not in batch:
745	            raise ValueError("Stochastic export requires sample_id in every DataLoader batch")
746	        sample_ids.extend(str(value) for value in batch["sample_id"])
747	        labels.append(batch["label"].cpu())
748	        images = batch["image"].to(device)
749	        temporal_mask = batch.get("temporal_mask")
750	        if temporal_mask is not None:
751	            logits.append(model(images, temporal_mask=temporal_mask.to(device)).cpu())
752	        else:
753	            logits.append(model(images).cpu())
754	    return {"sample_ids": sample_ids, "labels": torch.cat(labels), "logits": torch.cat(logits)}

757	@torch.no_grad()
758	def collect_mc_dropout_predictions(
759	    model: torch.nn.Module,
760	    loader: DataLoader,
761	    device: torch.device,
762	    passes: int,
763	    limit_batches: Optional[int] = None,
764	) -> Dict[str, Any]:
765	    activation_audit = activate_downstream_mc_dropout(model)
766	    outputs = [_collect_prediction_pass(model, loader, device, limit_batches) for _ in range(passes)]
767	    reference_ids = outputs[0]["sample_ids"]
768	    reference_labels = outputs[0]["labels"]
769	    if any(output["sample_ids"] != reference_ids for output in outputs[1:]):
770	        raise ValueError("MC Dropout DataLoader order changed between passes")
771	    if any(not torch.equal(output["labels"], reference_labels) for output in outputs[1:]):
772	        raise ValueError("MC Dropout labels changed between passes")
773	    return {
774	        "sample_ids": reference_ids,
775	        "labels": reference_labels,
776	        "stochastic_logits": torch.stack([output["logits"] for output in outputs], dim=1),
777	        "activation_audit": activation_audit,
778	    }

54	def compute_ece(probs, labels, n_bins=15):
55	    confidences, predictions = probs.max(dim=1)
56	    accuracies = predictions.eq(labels).float()
57	
58	    ece = torch.zeros((), device=probs.device)
59	    bin_boundaries = torch.linspace(0, 1, n_bins + 1, device=probs.device)
60	
61	    for index, (lower, upper) in enumerate(zip(bin_boundaries[:-1], bin_boundaries[1:])):
62	        if index == 0:
63	            in_bin = (confidences >= lower) & (confidences <= upper)
64	        else:
65	            in_bin = (confidences > lower) & (confidences <= upper)
66	        prop_in_bin = in_bin.float().mean()
67	        if prop_in_bin.item() == 0:
68	            continue
69	
70	        bin_accuracy = accuracies[in_bin].mean()
71	        bin_confidence = confidences[in_bin].mean()
72	        ece += (bin_confidence - bin_accuracy).abs() * prop_in_bin
73	
74	    return ece

77	def calibration_bins(
78	    probs: torch.Tensor,
79	    labels: torch.Tensor,
80	    n_bins: int = 15,
81	) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
82	    confidences, predictions = probs.max(dim=1)
83	    correct = predictions.eq(labels).float()
84	
85	    bin_edges = torch.linspace(0, 1, n_bins + 1, device=probs.device)
86	    bin_acc = torch.zeros(n_bins, device=probs.device)
87	    bin_conf = torch.zeros(n_bins, device=probs.device)
88	    bin_counts = torch.zeros(n_bins, device=probs.device)
89	
90	    for index, (lower, upper) in enumerate(zip(bin_edges[:-1], bin_edges[1:])):
91	        if index == 0:
92	            in_bin = (confidences >= lower) & (confidences <= upper)
93	        else:
94	            in_bin = (confidences > lower) & (confidences <= upper)
95	        if not in_bin.any():
96	            continue
97	        bin_acc[index] = correct[in_bin].mean()
98	        bin_conf[index] = confidences[in_bin].mean()
99	        bin_counts[index] = in_bin.sum()
100	
101	    return bin_edges, bin_acc, bin_conf, bin_counts, confidences

202	class TemperatureScaling(nn.Module):
203	    """Simple temperature scaling post-hoc calibration.
204	
205	    Usage:
206	        ts = TemperatureScaling()
207	        ts.fit(logits, labels)
208	        probs = ts.predict_proba(logits)
209	    """
210	
211	    def __init__(self):
212	        super().__init__()
213	        self.temperature = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(1) * 1.0)
214	
215	    def forward(self, logits: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
216	        return logits / self.temperature
217	
218	    def predict_proba(self, logits: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
219	        scaled = self.forward(logits)
220	        return F.softmax(scaled, dim=1)
221	
222	    def fit(self, logits: torch.Tensor, labels: torch.Tensor, max_iter: int = 200):
223	        """Fit temperature on validation logits/labels by minimizing NLL."""
224	        device = logits.device
225	        self.to(device)
226	
227	        logits = logits.clone().detach().to(device)
228	        labels = labels.clone().detach().to(device)
229	
230	        nll_criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
231	
232	        optimizer = torch.optim.LBFGS([self.temperature], lr=0.01, max_iter=max_iter)
233	
234	        def closure():
235	            optimizer.zero_grad()
236	            loss = nll_criterion(self.forward(logits), labels)
237	            loss.backward()
238	            return loss
239	
240	        optimizer.step(closure)
241	        return float(self.temperature.item())
242	
243	
244	TemperatureScaler = TemperatureScaling

248	def _bn_equal(left: dict[str, tuple[Any, ...]], right: dict[str, tuple[Any, ...]]) -> bool:
249	    if left.keys() != right.keys():
250	        return False
251	    return all(

253	        for key in left for a, b in zip(left[key], right[key])

257	def _classification_uncertainty(probabilities: np.ndarray, classification_type: str) -> dict[str, np.ndarray]:
258	    values = np.asarray(probabilities, dtype=np.float64)
259	    mean = values.mean(axis=1)
260	    variance = values.var(axis=1)
261	    eps = np.finfo(np.float64).tiny
262	    if classification_type == "multiclass":
263	        predictive = -(mean * np.log(np.clip(mean, eps, 1.0))).sum(axis=1)
264	        per_pass = -(values * np.log(np.clip(values, eps, 1.0))).sum(axis=2)
265	        expected = per_pass.mean(axis=1)
266	        disagreement = predictive - expected
267	        return {
268	            "mean_probabilities": mean.astype(np.float32),
269	            "predictive_entropy": predictive.astype(np.float32),
270	            "expected_predictive_entropy": expected.astype(np.float32),
271	            "mi_style_disagreement": disagreement.astype(np.float32),
272	            "predictive_variance": variance.astype(np.float32),
273	        }
274	    if classification_type != "multilabel":
275	        raise ValueError(classification_type)
276	    clipped_mean = np.clip(mean, eps, 1.0 - 1.0e-15)
277	    clipped = np.clip(values, eps, 1.0 - 1.0e-15)
278	    predictive_per_label = -(
279	        clipped_mean * np.log(clipped_mean) + (1.0 - clipped_mean) * np.log(1.0 - clipped_mean)
280	    )
281	    per_pass = -(clipped * np.log(clipped) + (1.0 - clipped) * np.log(1.0 - clipped))
282	    expected_per_label = per_pass.mean(axis=1)
283	    disagreement_per_label = predictive_per_label - expected_per_label
284	    return {
285	        "mean_probabilities": mean.astype(np.float32),
286	        "predictive_entropy_per_label": predictive_per_label.astype(np.float32),
287	        "expected_predictive_entropy_per_label": expected_per_label.astype(np.float32),
288	        "mi_style_disagreement_per_label": disagreement_per_label.astype(np.float32),
289	        # Per-label values are the unreduced scientific archive.  The scalar
290	        # sample summaries use the joint independent-Bernoulli entropy sum,
291	        # matching the existing final prediction-export convention.
292	        "predictive_entropy": predictive_per_label.sum(axis=1).astype(np.float32),
293	        "expected_predictive_entropy": expected_per_label.sum(axis=1).astype(np.float32),
294	        "mi_style_disagreement": disagreement_per_label.sum(axis=1).astype(np.float32),
295	        "predictive_variance": variance.astype(np.float32),
296	    }

486	def _segmentation_uncertainty(probabilities: torch.Tensor) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
487	    values = probabilities.double()
488	    mean = values.mean(dim=1)
489	    predictive = -(mean * mean.clamp_min(1.0e-12).log()).sum(dim=1)
490	    expected = -(values * values.clamp_min(1.0e-12).log()).sum(dim=2).mean(dim=1)
491	    return {
492	        "mean_probabilities": mean.float(),
493	        "predictive_entropy": predictive.float(),
494	        "expected_predictive_entropy": expected.float(),
495	        "mi_style_disagreement": (predictive - expected).float(),
496	        "predictive_variance": values.var(dim=1, unbiased=False).float(),
497	    }

3	"""Shared downstream-head/decoder MC Dropout mode controls."""
4	
5	from typing import Any
6	
7	import torch.nn as nn
8	
9	
10	_STOCHASTIC_TYPES = (nn.Dropout, nn.Dropout1d, nn.Dropout2d, nn.Dropout3d)
11	_BATCHNORM_TYPES = (nn.BatchNorm1d, nn.BatchNorm2d, nn.BatchNorm3d)
12	
13	
14	def designate_mc_dropout(module: nn.Module, placement: str) -> nn.Module:
15	    if not isinstance(module, _STOCHASTIC_TYPES):
16	        raise TypeError("Only standard PyTorch dropout modules can be designated for MC inference")
17	    if not 0.0 < float(module.p) < 1.0:
18	        raise ValueError("Designated MC Dropout must have 0 < p < 1")
19	    module._mc_dropout_designated = True
20	    module._mc_dropout_placement = str(placement)
21	    return module
22	
23	
24	def designated_mc_dropout_modules(model: nn.Module) -> list[tuple[str, nn.Module]]:
25	    return [
26	        (name or "<root>", module)
27	        for name, module in model.named_modules()
28	        if bool(getattr(module, "_mc_dropout_designated", False))
29	    ]
30	
31	
32	def activate_downstream_mc_dropout(model: nn.Module) -> dict[str, Any]:
33	    """Enable only explicitly designated downstream dropout while all other layers stay in eval mode."""
34	
35	    model.eval()
36	    designated = designated_mc_dropout_modules(model)
37	    if len(designated) != 1:
38	        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected exactly one designated MC Dropout module, found {len(designated)}")
39	    for _, module in designated:
40	        module.train()
41	
42	    batchnorm_training = [
43	        name or "<root>" for name, module in model.named_modules()
44	        if isinstance(module, _BATCHNORM_TYPES) and module.training
45	    ]
46	    non_designated_training = [
47	        name or "<root>" for name, module in model.named_modules()
48	        if isinstance(module, _STOCHASTIC_TYPES)
49	        and module.training
50	        and not bool(getattr(module, "_mc_dropout_designated", False))
51	    ]
52	    backbone_stochastic_training = [
53	        name for name, module in model.named_modules()
54	        if name.startswith("backbone.") and isinstance(module, _STOCHASTIC_TYPES) and module.training
55	    ]
56	    if batchnorm_training:
57	        raise RuntimeError(f"BatchNorm unexpectedly active during MC inference: {batchnorm_training}")
58	    if non_designated_training or backbone_stochastic_training:
59	        raise RuntimeError(
60	            "Only the designated downstream dropout may be active during MC inference: "
61	            f"non_designated={non_designated_training}, backbone={backbone_stochastic_training}"
62	        )
63	    return {
64	        "model_training": model.training,
65	        "designated_modules": [
66	            {
67	                "path": name,
68	                "class": type(module).__name__,
69	                "p": float(module.p),
70	                "placement": str(getattr(module, "_mc_dropout_placement")),
71	                "training": module.training,
72	            }
73	            for name, module in designated
74	        ],
75	        "batchnorm_training_modules": batchnorm_training,
76	        "non_designated_stochastic_training_modules": non_designated_training,
77	        "backbone_stochastic_training_modules": backbone_stochastic_training,

1	# C3 — TreeSatAI validation-fitted Temperature Scaling
2	
3	Created: 2026-08-24T21:30:50.312553+00:00
4	
5	TreeSatAI uses the downloaded official GEO-Bench-2 train/validation/test artifact. It has no independent calibration split. Under the final thesis protocol, one positive scalar temperature is therefore fitted to each checkpoint's official validation logits. This official validation split was also used for checkpoint selection; that dual use is an explicit protocol difference from EuroSAT, which uses a dedicated calibration split.
6	
7	The official test split remained untouched during fitting. No temperature was selected, rejected, or adjusted from test performance, and no neural-network weight was changed. All reported test results apply the validation-fitted temperature prospectively to the existing saved test logits.
8	
9	TreeSatAI is multilabel: Accuracy is strict exact match, Macro-F1 is label-macro positive-class F1, NLL and Brier average all sample-label decisions, and ECE-15 uses flattened binary-decision confidence. A positive scalar leaves both each 0.5-threshold prediction vector and the per-sample argmax label unchanged; both invariants were verified for every checkpoint.
10

112	    result: dict[str, Any] = {}
113	    for metric in metrics:

430	def softmax(logits: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
431	    shifted = logits - logits.max(axis=1, keepdims=True)
432	    exp = np.exp(shifted)

471	def reliability_points(labels: np.ndarray, probabilities: np.ndarray, multilabel: bool, bins: int = 15) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
472	    if multilabel:
473	        confidence = probabilities.reshape(-1)
474	        outcome = labels.reshape(-1).astype(float)
475	    else:
476	        prediction = probabilities.argmax(axis=1)
477	        confidence = probabilities.max(axis=1)
478	        outcome = (prediction == labels.astype(int)).astype(float)
479	    index = np.minimum((confidence * bins).astype(np.int64), bins - 1)
480	    count = np.bincount(index, minlength=bins).astype(float)
481	    conf_sum = np.bincount(index, weights=confidence, minlength=bins)
482	    outcome_sum = np.bincount(index, weights=outcome, minlength=bins)
483	    valid = count > 0
484	    return conf_sum[valid] / count[valid], outcome_sum[valid] / count[valid], count[valid]

73	def require(condition: bool, message: str) -> None:

78	def read_master() -> list[dict[str, str]]:

85	def number(value: Any) -> float | None:
86	    if value is None or value == "":
87	        return None
88	    parsed = float(value)
89	    return parsed if math.isfinite(parsed) else None
90

92	def seed_number(row: dict[str, str]) -> int | None:
93	    value = number(row.get("seed"))

98	    return "accuracy" if task == "classification" else "miou"

101	def empty_effect(**values: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
102	    row = {field: None for field in FIELDS}
103	    row.update(values)
104	    return row

107	def unique_join(values: Iterable[str], *, split_sources: bool = False) -> str:
108	    output: list[str] = []
109	    for raw in values:
110	        candidates = raw.split(";") if split_sources and raw else [raw]
111	        for value in candidates:
112	            if value and value not in output:
113	                output.append(value)
114	    return ";".join(output)

117	def provenance(rows: list[dict[str, str]], prefix: str) -> dict[str, str]:
118	    return {
119	        f"{prefix}_record_type": unique_join(row["record_type"] for row in rows),
120	        f"{prefix}_run_ids": unique_join(row["run_id"] for row in rows),
121	        f"{prefix}_checkpoint_paths": unique_join(row["checkpoint_path"] for row in rows),
122	        f"{prefix}_checkpoint_sha256s": unique_join(row["checkpoint_sha256"] for row in rows),
123	        f"{prefix}_source_paths": unique_join((row["source_paths"] for row in rows), split_sources=True),
124	    }

127	def set_task_performance(row: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
128	    metric = row["primary_performance_metric"]
129	    for stem in ("baseline", "comparison", "delta"):
130	        row[f"{stem}_task_performance"] = row.get(f"{stem}_{metric}")
131	        row[f"{stem}_task_performance_std"] = row.get(f"{stem}_{metric}_std")

134	def seed_effect(
135	    baseline: dict[str, str],
136	    comparison: dict[str, str],
137	    **identity: Any,
138	) -> dict[str, Any]:
139	    row = empty_effect(**identity)
140	    for metric in METRICS:
141	        before = number(baseline.get(metric))
142	        after = number(comparison.get(metric))
143	        require((before is None) == (after is None), f"Metric applicability mismatch: {metric}")
144	        row[f"baseline_{metric}"] = before
145	        row[f"comparison_{metric}"] = after
146	        row[f"delta_{metric}"] = None if before is None else after - before
147	    row.update(provenance([baseline], "baseline"))
148	    row.update(provenance([comparison], "comparison"))
149	    set_task_performance(row)
150	    return row

153	def mean_std(values: list[float]) -> tuple[float, float]:
154	    require(len(values) >= 2, "At least two values are required for sample std")
155	    return statistics.fmean(values), statistics.stdev(values)

158	def assert_close(actual: float | None, expected: float | None, label: str) -> None:
159	    require((actual is None) == (expected is None), f"Missing-value mismatch for {label}")
160	    if actual is not None:
161	        require(math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-10, abs_tol=1e-12), f"Value mismatch for {label}: {actual} vs {expected}")

164	def paired_summary(
165	    seed_rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
166	    baseline_master_rows: list[dict[str, str]],
167	    comparison_master_rows: list[dict[str, str]],
168	    **identity: Any,
169	) -> dict[str, Any]:
170	    require(len(seed_rows) == len(baseline_master_rows) == len(comparison_master_rows) == 3, "Paired summary must contain three seeds")
171	    row = empty_effect(**identity)
172	    for metric in METRICS:
173	        baseline_values = [number(item[f"baseline_{metric}"]) for item in seed_rows]
174	        comparison_values = [number(item[f"comparison_{metric}"]) for item in seed_rows]
175	        delta_values = [number(item[f"delta_{metric}"]) for item in seed_rows]
176	        if all(value is None for value in baseline_values):
177	            require(all(value is None for value in comparison_values + delta_values), f"Partial applicability for {metric}")
178	            continue
179	        require(all(value is not None for value in baseline_values + comparison_values + delta_values), f"Partial paired values for {metric}")
180	        for stem, values in (
181	            ("baseline", baseline_values),
182	            ("comparison", comparison_values),
183	            ("delta", delta_values),
184	        ):
185	            mean, std = mean_std(values)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
186	            row[f"{stem}_{metric}"] = mean
187	            row[f"{stem}_{metric}_std"] = std
188	    row.update(provenance(baseline_master_rows, "baseline"))
189	    row.update(provenance(comparison_master_rows, "comparison"))
190	    set_task_performance(row)
191	    return row

194	def compatible_identity(left: dict[str, str], right: dict[str, str], fields: Iterable[str]) -> None:
195	    for field in fields:
196	        require(left[field] == right[field], f"Identity mismatch for {field}: {left[field]} vs {right[field]}")

199	def master_index(rows: list[dict[str, str]], *, method: str, record_type: str) -> dict[tuple[Any, ...], dict[str, str]]:
200	    selected = [row for row in rows if row["uq_method"] == method and row["record_type"] == record_type and row["status"] == "COMPLETE"]
201	    index: dict[tuple[Any, ...], dict[str, str]] = {}
202	    for row in selected:
203	        key = (row["task"], row["dataset"], row["model"], row["adaptation"], seed_number(row))
204	        require(key not in index, f"Duplicate master key: {key}")
205	        index[key] = row
206	    return index

31	    if tokens.ndim != 3:
32	        raise ValueError(f"Dense adapter expected [B,N,D] patch tokens, got {tuple(tokens.shape)}")
33	    if grid_size is None:

36	            raise ValueError(f"Patch-token count {tokens.shape[1]} is not a square grid")
37	        height = width = side
38	    else:
39	        height, width = (int(value) for value in grid_size)
40	        if height * width != tokens.shape[1]:
41	            raise ValueError(
42	                f"Configured patch grid {(height, width)} does not match {tokens.shape[1]} patch tokens"
43	            )

47	class DOFADenseFeatureAdapter(nn.Module):
48	    """Expose DOFA's final normalized patch tokens without global pooling."""
49	
50	    def __init__(self, backbone: nn.Module, wavelengths_um: Sequence[float]) -> None:
51	        super().__init__()
52	        self.backbone = backbone
53	        self.wavelengths_um = tuple(float(value) for value in wavelengths_um)
54	        if not self.wavelengths_um or any(not 0.3 <= value <= 2.5 for value in self.wavelengths_um):
55	            raise ValueError("DOFA dense adapter requires optical wavelengths in micrometers")
56	
57	    def forward(self, image: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
58	        if image.ndim != 4 or image.shape[1] != len(self.wavelengths_um):
59	            raise ValueError(
60	                f"DOFA dense input must be [B,{len(self.wavelengths_um)},H,W], got {tuple(image.shape)}"
61	            )
62	        waves = image.new_tensor(self.wavelengths_um)
63	        patches, _ = self.backbone.patch_embed(image, waves)
64	        if patches.ndim != 3:
65	            raise ValueError(f"DOFA patch_embed returned unexpected shape {tuple(patches.shape)}")
66	        position = self.backbone.pos_embed[:, 1 : 1 + patches.shape[1], :]
67	        if position.shape[1] != patches.shape[1]:
68	            raise ValueError("DOFA positional embedding does not match the configured input patch grid")
69	        patches = patches + position
70	        cls_token = self.backbone.cls_token + self.backbone.pos_embed[:, :1, :]
71	        tokens = torch.cat((cls_token.expand(patches.shape[0], -1, -1), patches), dim=1)
72	        for block in self.backbone.blocks:
73	            tokens = block(tokens)
74	        normalization = getattr(self.backbone, "norm", None) or getattr(self.backbone, "fc_norm", None)
75	        if normalization is None:
76	            raise ValueError("DOFA backbone exposes neither norm nor fc_norm for dense tokens")
77	        patch_tokens = normalization(tokens)[:, 1:, :]
78	        grid_size = getattr(getattr(self.backbone, "patch_embed", None), "grid_size", None)
79	        return _tokens_to_feature_map(patch_tokens, grid_size=grid_size)

110	class UNetDecoderBlock(nn.Module):
111	    def __init__(self, input_channels: int, output_channels: int) -> None:
112	        super().__init__()
113	        groups = min(32, output_channels)
114	        while output_channels % groups:
115	            groups -= 1
116	        self.block = nn.Sequential(
117	            nn.Conv2d(input_channels, output_channels, kernel_size=3, padding=1, bias=False),
118	            nn.GroupNorm(groups, output_channels),
119	            nn.GELU(),
120	            nn.Conv2d(output_channels, output_channels, kernel_size=3, padding=1, bias=False),
121	            nn.GroupNorm(groups, output_channels),
122	            nn.GELU(),
123	        )
124	
125	    def forward(self, features: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
126	        features = F.interpolate(features, scale_factor=2.0, mode="bilinear", align_corners=False)
127	        return self.block(features)

130	class CommonUNetDecoder(nn.Module):
131	    """Shared skip-free U-Net-style upsampling decoder for transformer features."""
132	
133	    def __init__(
134	        self,
135	        input_channels: int,
136	        num_classes: int,
137	        decoder_channels: Sequence[int] = (256, 128, 64, 32),
138	        dropout: float = 0.0,
139	    ) -> None:
140	        super().__init__()
141	        if not decoder_channels or any(int(value) <= 0 for value in decoder_channels):
142	            raise ValueError("decoder_channels must contain positive channel counts")
143	        blocks = []
144	        current_channels = int(input_channels)
145	        for output_channels in decoder_channels:
146	            blocks.append(UNetDecoderBlock(current_channels, int(output_channels)))
147	            current_channels = int(output_channels)
148	        self.blocks = nn.Sequential(*blocks)
149	        dropout = float(dropout)
150	        if not 0.0 <= dropout < 1.0:
151	            raise ValueError("segmentation decoder dropout must satisfy 0 <= p < 1")
152	        self.mc_dropout: nn.Module = nn.Identity()
153	        if dropout > 0.0:
154	            self.mc_dropout = designate_mc_dropout(
155	                nn.Dropout2d(dropout), "common_decoder_final_feature_map_before_1x1_classifier"
156	            )
157	        self.classifier = nn.Conv2d(current_channels, int(num_classes), kernel_size=1)
158	
159	    def forward(self, features: torch.Tensor, output_size: Sequence[int]) -> torch.Tensor:
160	        logits = self.classifier(self.mc_dropout(self.blocks(features)))
161	        if tuple(logits.shape[-2:]) != tuple(output_size):
162	            logits = F.interpolate(logits, size=tuple(output_size), mode="bilinear", align_corners=False)
163	        return logits

277	def audit_segmentation_model(model: FoundationSegmentationModel, model_cfg: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
278	    backbone_total = sum(parameter.numel() for parameter in model.backbone.parameters())
279	    backbone_trainable = sum(parameter.numel() for parameter in model.backbone.parameters() if parameter.requires_grad)
280	    decoder_total = sum(parameter.numel() for parameter in model.head.parameters())
281	    decoder_trainable = sum(parameter.numel() for parameter in model.head.parameters() if parameter.requires_grad)
282	    frozen = str(model_cfg.get("adaptation_mode")) == "frozen"
283	    if frozen and backbone_trainable:
284	        raise RuntimeError("Frozen segmentation adaptation has trainable backbone parameters")
285	    if not frozen and backbone_trainable == 0:
286	        raise RuntimeError("Full-finetune segmentation adaptation has no trainable backbone parameters")
287	    structurally_frozen = {
288	        name: parameter.numel() for name, parameter in model.backbone.named_parameters() if not parameter.requires_grad
289	    }
290	    if not frozen:
291	        expected_frozen = {f"backbone.{name}" for name in model_cfg.get("expected_frozen_backbone_parameters", [])}
292	        if set(structurally_frozen) != expected_frozen:
293	            raise RuntimeError(
294	                "Full-finetune segmentation freeze invariant failed: "
295	                f"expected={sorted(expected_frozen)}, actual={sorted(structurally_frozen)}"
296	            )
297	    if decoder_total == 0 or decoder_trainable != decoder_total:
298	        raise RuntimeError("The common segmentation decoder must be fully trainable")
299	    model.train()
300	    if frozen and model.backbone.training:
301	        raise RuntimeError("Frozen segmentation backbone must remain in eval mode")
302	    configured_dropout = float(model_cfg.get("decoder", {}).get("dropout", 0.0))
303	    designated = designated_mc_dropout_modules(model)
304	    if configured_dropout == 0.0 and designated:
305	        raise RuntimeError("Deterministic segmentation decoder unexpectedly designates MC Dropout")
306	    if configured_dropout > 0.0 and (
307	        len(designated) != 1
308	        or not isinstance(designated[0][1], nn.Dropout2d)
309	        or not math.isclose(float(designated[0][1].p), configured_dropout, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=0.0)
310	    ):
311	        raise RuntimeError("MC segmentation decoder must expose exactly one configured Dropout2d")
312	    return {
313	        "adaptation_mode": model_cfg.get("adaptation_mode"),
314	        "backbone_total_parameters": backbone_total,
315	        "backbone_trainable_parameters": backbone_trainable,
316	        "backbone_requires_grad_all_false": backbone_trainable == 0,
317	        "backbone_structurally_frozen_parameters": structurally_frozen,
318	        "decoder_total_parameters": decoder_total,
319	        "decoder_trainable_parameters": decoder_trainable,
320	        "decoder_class": type(model.head).__name__,
321	        "mc_dropout": [
322	            {
323	                "path": name,
324	                "class": type(module).__name__,
325	                "p": float(module.p),
326	                "placement": str(getattr(module, "_mc_dropout_placement")),
327	            }
328	            for name, module in designated
329	        ],
330	        "dense_adapter_class": type(model.backbone).__name__,
331	        "pretrained_load": getattr(model.backbone.backbone, "_pretrained_load_audit", None),
332	    }
